english.note: 自從嗰次 means since that time.

exampleSentences.english: Really? He hasn’t contacted me since that time, when the killing intent was so strong.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係咩？佢都冇揾過我喇，自從嗰次殺氣，殺氣好重嗰次之後。

exampleSentences.english: Ever since I queued for eight hours that time, don’t mess with me anymore. It was awful—standing for eight hours.
